SELECT
    toYear(DateKey) AS Year,
    sum(SalesAmount) AS TotalSalesAmount,
    sum(SalesQuantity) AS TotalSalesQuantity,
    round(
        (sum(SalesAmount) - lagInFrame(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey))) /
        lagInFrame(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toYear(DateKey)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS YoY_Growth_Pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
GROUP BY Year
ORDER BY Year
